description: Refactor cryptoAccounts.py from a 918-line monolithic class into a well-organized, testable architecture by extracting specialized query classes and removing legacy code
principles: Single Responsibility - Each query class has one focused purpose
Dependency Injection - All query classes use constructor injection
Backward Compatibility - All public method signatures preserved
Test Coverage - Add tests before refactoring risky code
Incremental Changes - One story per commit with verification

techStack.pattern: Query Object Pattern with dependency injection
